integrity: The universal proof is symbolic. The bundled exhaustive checker is used only as a finite consistency test of the match-interval/run correspondence. No independent audit is claimed.
scientific_limitations: The result does not prove the conjectured coefficient 1. The constants 23/20 and 11/10 inherit current bounds for the sum of run exponents and may be improvable by exploiting which period multiples actually yield distinct reductions.
title: Run-exponent bounds for one-step square reductions
